'''2005 Norwegian National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship in Norway (25 April 2005).<ref name="pc-events05">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing (updated 27 June 2005)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 28 August 2005.</ref> [[Thomas Caspersen]] and Thomas Andersen won its two Day 2 byes.<ref name="pc-events05" /> It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Norway
* '''Dates:''' 25 April 2005<ref name="pc-events05" />
